description: Provenance manifest for curated source files under pipeline/sources/. These files are not ingested by the pipeline (ingest.py reads only the named entity files); they document the origin of data used by the figure system and record what still needs curation.

sources.purpose: Hourly low-cost sensor readings (PM2.5, NO2, VOCs) from the Virginia DEQ Data Center Air Monitoring Project, reshaped to one row per site-hour-pollutant.
sources.retrieval_method: public Kunak Cloud CSV export, method confirmed by DEQ staff 2026-08-10
sources.license: Fully redistributable with credit that the data belong to Virginia DEQ (per DEQ staff, 2026-08-10). Preferred attribution line pending from DEQ Communications.
sources.format: CSV
sources.raw_inputs: pipeline/sources/deq-raw/<site-slug>_multi_2026-03-03_2026-08-28.csv (6 files, semicolon-delimited with a sep=; preamble, reverse-chronological). The 2026-08-10 set it replaced is retained under deq-raw/_superseded/ and is not ingested.
sources.description: Kunak values are hour-ending and DST-adjusted. ts_est normalises them to hour-beginning EST by shifting back 1 hour before 2026-03-08 03:00 and 2 hours on and after, per DEQ's instruction of 2026-08-11; ts_raw is retained unmodified and shift_hours records the shift applied. Values are flagged, never deleted and never nulled: exact 0.0 readings are kept in value with excluded=true, exclusion_reason=exact_zero_floor, and zero_run_length giving the length of the consecutive zero run (longest observed: NO2 45h, VOCs 53h, PM2.5 16h). DEQ voided Kunak PM2.5 for 2026-03-03 to 2026-03-08 inclusive for high humidity and data quality. excluded means failed validity only; v1_scope carries scope. This file must never be merged into one series with the regulatory monitor data: DEQ's CFR limitation language applies to these sensors alone.
sources.limitations: DEQ publishes these values as detected; they have not passed quality assurance validation and carry no null code, flag, or qualifier column. Three retired sites (heritage-farm, newberry-condo, steuart-weller) appear in deq_sensor_site_history.csv but have no export, so rules scoped to them match zero rows. Meteorological data is not exportable. VOCs are recorded but not used: Broad Run HS readings span three orders of magnitude with cause unknown.

sources.purpose: Hourly regulatory reference monitor readings (PM2.5, NO2, CO) released under FOIA, reshaped to one row per site-hour-pollutant.
sources.retrieval_method: Virginia FOIA request 26-4646, released in full 2026-08-11
sources.license: Public records released in full under the Virginia Freedom of Information Act, no redactions, no cost. Credit Virginia DEQ.
sources.format: CSV
sources.raw_inputs: pipeline/sources/deq-regulatory/*.xls (4 OLE2 files read with xlrd, sheet Sheet1)
sources.coverage: 2026-03-03 to 2026-08-10, 11592 rows: ASHBURN PM2.5 (method 638) and NO2 (method 212), AURHILL CO (method 54)
sources.description: Regulatory values are hour-beginning and always EST, so ts_raw equals ts_est. A reading is excluded if and only if Value is NaN, an AQS Null Code is present, or Flags contains '<' (Logger Invalid); never on a letter code alone. Flags are case-sensitive and are never lowercased: C is Calibration and c is Ceiling Limit, H is High-High Alarm and h is High Alarm, I is Invalidated By Edit and l is Low Alarm. Parameter, AQS Method Code and Average Interval are carried through as the documentary basis for the instrument-class distinction. The fourth released file, AshburnPM2.5_dailyAvg_030326_081026.xls, is a daily series and is not part of this table; it is used only to reconcile deq_pm25_daily.csv.
sources.scope_note: Aurora Hills (AURHILL) CO is released and reshaped but is outside v1 scope: the site is in Arlington, not Loudoun. Those rows carry v1_scope=out_of_scope and scope_reason=out_of_county_reference_arlington, with excluded set purely on validity as for any other row. DEQ's 2026-08-07 report names Aurora Hills as the closest comparable CO regulatory site to the Loudoun sensors and plots it alongside them, so the data may be used later. Kunak reports CO as an 8-hour average while this file is 1-hour, so the two are not directly comparable.
sources.limitations: The published daily-average file applies no completeness threshold and is itself unfiltered, reporting values computed from as little as one valid hour. deq_pm25_daily.csv recomputes from hourly with the DEQ-confirmed 18-of-24 rule and truncates to one decimal without rounding; it reproduces the published file on 118 of 119 comparable days.

sources.purpose: Figure C3 (gwas-ancestry-imbalance): share of GWAS participants by ancestry group.
sources.license: GWAS Catalog data is distributed by EMBL-EBI under open terms; the 2023 snapshot is quoted from the Cell Genomics 2024 diversity-gap review (citation, not redistribution).
sources.format: CSV
sources.status: PARTIAL. Figure C3 is NOT shipped.
sources.blocker: The figure needs a matched world/global population share by the SAME ancestry categories (the Morales et al. 2018 framework the GWAS Diversity Monitor uses). Neither the GWAS Diversity Monitor nor the Cell Genomics 2024 review publishes matched world-population percentages; the review explicitly notes the absence of a standardized global baseline. Do not attach a differently-defined population source (for example UN residents-in-Europe, ~10%) to the GWAS ancestry share, because the two bars would then measure different things. To unblock: curate a same-framework world-population-by-ancestry table from a single citable source with an as-of date, add it here, then build the two-bar figure.

sources.purpose: Figure C4 (food-access-t2d): tract-level food access vs diagnosed-diabetes prevalence across Loudoun County census tracts.
sources.status: SPEC ONLY. Figure C4 is NOT shipped.
sources.format: specification
sources.blocker: The community dataset holds only a single county-level food-access summary (low_access_pct = 4.5). The scatter needs one row per census tract pairing a food-access measure with a diabetes-prevalence measure. That paired table does not exist and must be curated per the README before the figure can be built. No values were synthesized.

sources.purpose: County boundary geometry for the /community/[region] map (Branch B, county-level rendering).
sources.license: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb / TIGER-Line — public domain (U.S. Government work, not copyrighted).
sources.format: GeoJSON (FeatureCollection, WGS84 / EPSG:4326)
sources.description: One real county polygon per region, keyed by fips_code (GEOID). Fetched via pipeline/fetch_geo.py and committed to the repo; the static site build does not fetch. This replaced a prior hand-drawn Fairfax outline and added the previously missing Loudoun boundary.

sources.purpose: A true sub-county choropleth on /community/[region]: per-census-tract exposure values so the single county polygon can be replaced by a graded tract choropleth.
sources.status: BLOCKED. The community map renders at county resolution only.
sources.format: specification
sources.blocker: The community dataset holds only one county-level scalar per exposure layer (e.g., Loudoun PM2.5 mean = 9.2 µg/m³). A choropleth needs Census TIGER/Line 2023 census-tract geometry for FIPS 51107 (Loudoun) and 51059 (Fairfax) joined to per-tract exposure values (EPA AQS / EJSCREEN for PM2.5 and traffic proximity, USDA Food Access Atlas for food access, CDC PLACES for health burden). That per-tract table does not exist and must be curated before a tract choropleth can be built. No values were synthesized.
